{{Top|leg}}
A '''glow-pearl''' was a type of gemstone that was sometimes used as [[Currency/Legends|currency]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], along with the [[fire node]] and [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystal]]. This stone was also used in an interior design capacity. They were embedded in walls and ceilings in distinctive design patterns.
